label: Sleek Pages
what_it_is: A fast, focused page (or small set) when speed-to-publish matters more than a full multi-page site.
best_for: Campaigns, offers, and simple presence needs
Clients who need something sharp quickly
good_when: They do not need a large site architecture yet
not_good_when: They need a full institutional website with many sections
They need portals, apps, or business systems
expert_recommendation: Recommend when speed and focus beat a full website build.
upsell_only_when: They outgrow a single page and need a full websites package or system.
important_tradeoff: Speed and simplicity vs breadth of a full site.
